curated.note: Hand-curated against commit e031523. Not model-produced; verified_by_agent stays false.

module_responsibilities: Validates evidence and assesses proposed statements against existing knowledge, then applies or gates decisions deterministically.
Owns proposals, assessments, decisions, disputes and equivalences as immutable revisions keyed by content digest.
boundaries: Does not call a model; all policy decisions (create/update/dispute/escalate) are code.
Does not capture raw sources itself; it consumes fragments/evidence refs supplied by callers.

key_flows.name: evaluate
key_flows.description: evaluateCore scores a proposal against active knowledge and applies the deterministic policy.

key_flows.name: persist-decision
key_flows.description: createDecision writes an immutable decision row and its receipts.

risks_and_limits: Proposal matching is token/overlap based, not semantic; ambiguous matches are escalated, not auto-applied.
Curated narrative only; confidence is intentionally <=0.1.
unknowns: Real decision distribution and edge-case policy outcomes are not exercised here.
